title: JV Ejercito slams 'very arrogant' Chinese envoy

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Senior Deputy Majority Leader JV Ejercito on Saturday slammed Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan over his remarks on Manila’s response to Beijing’s actions in the West Philippine Sea, calling the envoy arrogant and saying he should be replaced. “Mayabang masyado ito (He is very arrogant),” Ejercito said of Jing in an interview on dWIZ. “Kapag nakita ko ‘yan, baka masiko ko ‘yan sa mukha, napakayabang mo (If I see him, I might elbow him in the face.
